findings.description: One entry per defect. Empty when the diff is clean.

severity.description: blocker: the diff is wrong and a user would hit it. major: wrong under a reachable input. minor: everything else.

failure.description: Concrete inputs or state, then the wrong output. A finding with no failure path is not a finding.

in_scope.description: True when the fix lands inside a file this diff already touches. False routes the finding to the PR body's Follow-ups instead of being fixed.
